notes.body: A hollow bolster woven from bamboo, leaned against in summer to keep cool while reclining.
A mu is a traditional Chinese unit of field area; three hundred mu marks Liu as a very large landowner.
Lord Guan is the deified general Guan Yu, commonly enshrined in village temples; his stern clay images were known for rigid, impassive silence.
notes.span: clay images enshrined in a Lord Guan temple

notes.body: A sun is a traditional unit of about three centimetres, so about nine centimetres long.
Cao Mengde is Cao Cao, the Three Kingdoms strategist; the tale has him quenching his soldiers' thirst by talking of a plum grove ahead.

data.say: Kept five recoverability notes and left in-line glosses and parody close to carry the rest.
